mapper.select:
SELECT R.RESV_ID AS resvId, R.RESV_NO AS resvNo, R.RESV_TYPE AS resvType, R.MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, R.STATUS_CD AS statusCd, R.TOTAL_AMOUNT AS totalAmount, R.MEMBER_COUPON_ID AS memberCouponId, R.COUPON_DISCOUNT AS couponDiscount, R.POINT_USED AS pointUsed, R.CHECKIN_DATE AS checkinDate, R.CHECKOUT_DATE AS checkoutDate, R.TARGET_ID AS targetId, S.NAME AS stayName FROM TB_RESERVATION R LEFT JOIN TB_STAY S ON R.RESV_TYPE = 'STAY' AND S.STAY_ID = TO_NUMBER(R.TARGET_ID) WHERE R.RESV_ID = #{resvId} AND R.RESV_TYPE = 'STAY'
AND R.TARGET_ID = TO_CHAR(#{stayId})

SELECT PAYMENT_ID AS "paymentId", TOSS_PAYMENT_KEY AS "tossPaymentKey", PAY_AMOUNT AS "payAmount", PAY_STATUS AS "payStatus", REFUND_AMT AS "refundAmt", PAY_METHOD AS "payMethod" FROM TB_PAYMENT WHERE RESV_ID = #{resvId} AND PAY_TYPE = 'RESERVATION' AND PAY_STATUS = 'DONE' AND ROWNUM = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_PAYMENT SET REFUND_AMT = #{refundAmt}, PAY_STATUS = 'REFUND' WHERE RESV_ID = #{resvId} AND PAY_TYPE = 'RESERVATION' AND PAY_STATUS = 'DONE'

UPDATE TB_RESERVATION SET STATUS_CD = 'CANCEL', REJECT_REASON = #{rejectReason, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CANCEL_FEE_AMT = #{cancelFeeAmt}, REFUND_AMT = #{refundAmt}, CANCEL_AT = SYSDATE WHERE RESV_ID = #{resvId} AND RESV_TYPE = 'STAY'
AND STATUS_CD NOT IN ('CANCEL', 'REJECTED')
AND STATUS_CD NOT IN ('CANCEL', 'REJECTED', 'DONE')
AND TARGET_ID = TO_CHAR(#{stayId})
mapper.select: SELECT NVL(POINT_BALANCE, 0) FROM TB_MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_POINT ( POINT_ID, MEMBER_NO, POINT_TYPE, POINT_AMOUNT, BALANCE_AFTER, REASON_CD, REF_TYPE, REF_ID, REG_DATE ) VALUES ( (SELECT NVL(MAX(POINT_ID), 0) + 1 FROM TB_POINT), #{memberNo}, 'REFUND', #{pointAmount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{reasonCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{refType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{refId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE )
